scientific_question: Can a deterministic JVP-based trust-region oracle find a complete-gate witness in the same four-increment span without repeating the v42 direct-SLSQP budget failure?

frozen_parent.v42_required_reason: each snapshot exhausted the 700-call direct curved-objective budget during the first SLSQP start

representation.directions: the same four sequential straight-ray CGLS increments used by v41 and v42

local_observation_model.directional_derivatives: four exact torch.func.jvp evaluations, one for each high-resolution Krylov increment
local_observation_model.surrogate: squared relative-L2 of the affine observation model

inner_convex_qcqp.solver: SLSQP on an analytic convex quadratic objective and two analytic convex quadratic truth constraints
starts: box-and-trust-region-clipped unconstrained affine least-squares solution when feasible after radial contraction to the center

hard_budget_per_snapshot.forward_breakdown: one Direct-K3 forward to reconstruct the frozen basis, one start-center forward, and at most eight exact candidate rescoring forwards

per_snapshot: field, gradient, and observation are each at most 1.01 times Direct-K4
field, gradient, and observation are each no worse than Zero
observation is no worse than Direct-K3 plus 1e-12
candidate is not Pareto dominated by Direct-K3
complete_gate.aggregate: median field, gradient, and observation are each no worse than the corresponding Direct-K4 median
complete_gate.fragile_margin: a witness with minimum margin below 1e-3 to any 1.01 Direct-K4 gate is fragile and does not authorize selector training

decision_rule.robust_witness: all four independently replayed final candidates pass every per-snapshot and aggregate gate with minimum 1.01 margin at least 1e-3
decision_rule.fragile_witness: the complete gate passes but the minimum 1.01 margin is below 1e-3
decision_rule.bounded_negative: the preregistered trust-region execution is valid but no complete-gate witness is found; this is not a proof that the span is infeasible
decision_rule.inconclusive: parent closure, basis parity, JVP, inner solve, finite checks, exact rescoring, budget, saved-field replay, or independent agreement fails
